question: Can a single exact finite BRST model classify twenty presently unmapped quantum-consistency coordinates while respecting the classify-before-QME-before-transfer order?
answer: Yes, for one explicitly scoped six-generator rational model. Exact cohomology classifies its ghost-zero counterterms and ghost-one anomalies; an exact counterterm removes a named one-loop defect; only then does a verified contraction transfer the renormalized correction. Seventeen cells become LOCAL_RESULT and three finite-product cells become PIECES_ONLY.

contraction.pi_cl: pi_cl(k)=k, pi_cl(r)=r, and pi_cl=0 on u,b,h,a
contraction.homotopy: H(b)=u, H(a)=h, and H=0 on u,h,k,r

carrier_realizations.hilbert: All maps are bounded rational 6x6 operators on Q^6 embedded in C^6 with the standard positive inner product; self-adjointness of Q is not asserted.
carrier_realizations.krein: J swaps u with b and h with a, fixes k, negates r, obeys J^2=I, and gives Q^sharp=J Q^T J=Q.
carrier_realizations.finite_products: The 36 rational matrix units span M_6(Q); all 1296 ordered basis products close exactly.
carrier_realizations.non_equivalence_boundary: These are representations of one finite complex, not equivalences among general finite, Hilbert, or Krein categories.
